page_title: BOL 2-1 FRO | Bologna v Frosinone 22/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+4' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) receives a yellow card from Daniele Doveri and because it's his second he will have an early bath.
90+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
88' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) gets booked for the first time in this match.
88' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
85' The substitution has been made. Kaio Jorge (Frosinone) has replaced Anthony Oyono.
85' A cross from the corner kick arrives at the feet of Riccardo Marchizza (Frosinone), giving him an opportunity to shoot. He misses completely, way over the bar.
84' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Frosinone will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
84' Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
84' Substitution. Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna) in, Remo Freuler out.
84' Here is a change. Lorenzo De Silvestri is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Tommaso Corazza (Bologna).
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Nikola Moro (Bologna) is replacing Alexis Saelemaekers.
75' Here comes a substitution. Enzo Barrenechea is given a rest as he is replaced by Marco Brescianini (Frosinone).
75' The game has come to an end for Reinier. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Arijon Ibrahimovic (Frosinone).
74' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) replaces Charalampos Lykogiannis.
74' Substitution. Riccardo Orsolini walks off the pitch and Dan Ndoye (Bologna) comes on as a substitute.
72' Bologna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
68' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Frosinone.
65' Frosinone take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
63' 2 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Matias Soule (Frosinone) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Lukasz Skorupski no chance!
63' Matias Soule (Frosinone) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
62' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Frosinone!

61' Play continues despite the shouts by some Frosinone players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Daniele Doveri interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
59' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
58' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
56' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Luca Garritano is replaced by Jaime Baez Stabile (Frosinone).
56' Substitution. Marvin Cuni (Frosinone) has come on for Walid Cheddira.
49' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) is adjudged offside.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Frosinone work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
42' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Lukasz Skorupski to dive and make a save.
42' A free kick on the edge of the box for Frosinone. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
40' Luca Mazzitelli (Frosinone) runs onto a rebound and unleashes a piledriver from distance that flies just wide of the right post.
40' Frosinone failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
40' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Caleb Okoli (Frosinone). Frosinone earn a corner.

32' What a poor attempt! Matias Soule (Frosinone) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
31' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
31' Luca Garritano (Frosinone) drills in an effort from the edge of the box that climbs rapidly and goes high over the bar.
25' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
25' The referee signals a corner kick to Bologna.

22' 2 - 0 Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) attempts to convert a rebound into a goal with a header from outside the box. He manages to surprise the defence and changes the score to 2:0 after striking the ball into the middle of the target.
19' 1 - 0 Goal! Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 1:0.
19' Anthony Oyono (Frosinone) takes a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
14' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Stefano Turati is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
13' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Bologna will have a throw-in.
10' Enzo Barrenechea (Frosinone) was too forceful with his tackle and Daniele Doveri interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
7' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Bologna will have the kick-off.
Daniele Doveri will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
